security_observability_notes: Campaign stacks (two host stacks and the lane sandboxes) torn down; host residue none; generated credentials archived outside Git and redacted in the raw log.

Every lane's private dockerd starts empty and pulls each pinned image from its registry: a four-lane campaign costs about four times the Docker Hub pulls of a serial one, and the unauthenticated limit of this host's address is 100 pulls per hour; a four-lane run right after another pulling run can fail at setup with 429 (the diagnostic attempt of this unit). Counter-measure applied: one pulling campaign per hour; a pull-through cache or seeding the lanes from the host image store (digest-pinned) would remove the risk and is a separate decision.
